# Grailed's commission is not a flat 9% any more.

> Free Grailed seller fee calculator for the tiered commission (6% under $120 with a $1.99 minimum, 9% from $120) plus 3.49% + $0.49 payment processing. See your payout, profit, the price for a target profit, and the $120 step where the whole sale jumps to 9%. Nothing leaves your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
